row.notes: Appends every track_data.track_layers row of the TrackDataSystem (+0x1e0..+0x1e8, stride 0x28) whose +0x0 mode mask, +0x4 season mask and +0x8 weekend format mask hold the query's bits to out_list (8-byte row pointers, u64 count at +0x100, room for 32, no bound check). Query bytes: [0] mode stat id, [1] mode used, [2] season stat id, [3] season used, [4] format bit, [5] format used; a criterion whose used byte is 0 is skipped. Mode or season >= 32 calls the bitset range failure 0x1411c04f0, format >= 2 calls 0x1402bedf0. Every matching row is added, not only the first. Only caller Game_GameMode_AddTrackLayerWorlds (0x1407a1383).
